notes: Colors from a website waits for the page to finish: loading screens, fonts, images and late content. The colors come from what the page actually shows, including styles added by JavaScript.
While it works, ColorBody shows each step (opening, loading all content, loading images further down, collecting colors) and tells you when a site is taking longer.
